sn51.6:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samattam iddhim abhinipphādesuṃ sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || ||
sn51.6:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samattam iddhim abhinipphādessanti || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || ||
sn51.6:1.3: Ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samattam iddhim abhinipphādenti sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ||
sn51.6:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.6:2.6: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samattaṃ iddhiṃ abhinipphādesuṃ || pe ||
sn51.6:2.8: abhinipphādenti || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā
